card.name: The word symptoms after signs and
card.fires_on: The word "symptoms" right after "signs and" in monitoring or warning instructions. It is followed by a condition such as asthma, hypotension or heart failure.

modes.label: The phrase "monitor for signs and symptoms"
modes.description: Instruction to watch for or educate about signs and symptoms of a named condition.
